limits: Only scalar Info-like Author, Creator and Producer fields are removed.
Unknown Creator identity, XMP and For markers are held; no stream removal.
Non-Info Producer is preserved only for known software; unsupported shapes are held.
Metadata verification does not replace full-page visual acceptance.

post_inventory.coverage: all xrefs and nested direct Author/Creator/Producer/Metadata fields; decoded non-image DSC/XMP markers

pre_inventory.coverage: all xrefs and nested direct Author/Creator/Producer/Metadata fields; decoded non-image DSC/XMP markers

review.notes: Inspected all 30 after-page renderings, compared before/after changes with plan.json and pages.json, and checked extracted PDF text, metadata, raw bytes, and annotations for forbidden identifiers. Differences were limited to planned redactions on pages 1, 4, and 10. Author/byline, affiliation/contact, arXiv side stamp, code/model footnote, acknowledgments, author contributions, venue/copyright notice, and hidden annotation/metadata clues were removed. Scientific content, references, figures, tables, page numbering, and ordinary citations are preserved without visible clipping.

token_usage.accounting_note: Input totals include cached input; output totals include reasoning output. These subsets are not added again. Totals cover reported usage only; attempts without usage may still have consumed tokens.
